question: Who are identified as the independent impellers of the lineage across the four ages?
premises: The four ages are invoked as a designation
They are impellers of the lineage
inference: The independent impellers of the lineage are identified in relation to the four ages.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of caturyuga iti to the rest of the verse is compressed
plain_english: Thus, O lord, they are the independent impellers of the lineage of the four ages.
